popupExpandToggleTip: Expand inner scrollable panels and iframes to the whole content instead of taking them the way they are shown. Frames from other websites ask for an extra permission one single time.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and are synchronised with your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission given – frames from other websites are expanded too.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames from other websites are taken the way they are shown. Panels and iframes from the same website always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Searches through the text the page shows, for e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, card numbers, national identity numbers and API keys, and lays a fully covering field over what hit, in the saved image. Text that is drawn as pixels it cannot read – a canvas, an image, a PDF, a video frame. The recognition runs on your device; nothing is ever sent anywhere. Applies to recordings of the whole page (document scrolling); the field is permanent, so look over the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF is played back everywhere. WebM is smaller and more even (it is recorded directly in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: The first time, a one-time permission is required in order to open these pages.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open those pages was turned down.
redactActsNone: The redaction found nothing in the text it read and painted no blocks. Nothing is marked below.
redactActsUncoveredOne: 1 hit is not covered in this image.
redactActsUncoveredOther: 2 hits are not covered in this image.
reviewLimit: FullShot reads the text a page exposes. It cannot see this image. Everything drawn as pixels – a canvas, an image, a PDF page, a video frame – was never read.
reviewNoMarks: No blocks are marked in the image below.
